newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn sets auction for Series 123 Bobls.
newsitem.headline: Bonn sets auction for Series 123 Bobls.

text.p: The Bonn government on Tuesday set an auction for about 10 billion marks of its Series 123 Bundesobligationen bonds, or Bobls, with bids from banks due by 0900 GMT on August 20, the Bundesbank as fiscal agent said.
Tap issuance of the Series 123 to non-bank investors ceases at 1000 GMT. The government started tap issuance of a new Series 124 Bobl to non-banks.
The new series carries a coupon of 4.50 percent, an issue price of 99.55 and a yield at issue of 4.60 percent, the Bundesbank said.
The new series 124 matures on August 19, 2002 and carries the securities number 114124.
